entities.name: PDU Session Modification Reject Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where SMF rejects a PDU session modification request by sending a PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message with appropriate cause value.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request modification of a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by SMF to reject a PDU session modification request.

entities.name: 5GSM Cause IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for rejecting PDU session modification.

entities.name: Back-off timer value IE
entities.description: Optional IE included in PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message to indicate back-off timer value.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: IE in PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST that may indicate 3GPP PS data off UE status.

entities.name: Timer T3581
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receipt of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by UE after receiving PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message.

entities.name: UE outside LADN service area
entities.description: Condition where UE requests PDU session modification while located outside LADN service area.

entities.name: 3GPP PS data off UE status change detected
entities.description: Condition where SMF detects change in 3GPP PS data off UE status.

entities.name: High priority access or emergency request
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for high priority access or request type is emergency-related.

relations.description: Procedure involves sending PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message contains 5GSM Cause IE.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message may contain Back-off timer value IE.
Condition triggers inclusion of cause value #46 in 5GSM Cause IE.
Condition prevents inclusion of certain cause values in 5GSM Cause IE.
Condition prevents inclusion of Back-off timer value IE.
Receipt of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message stops timer T3581.
Receipt of PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REJECT message causes UE to enter PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
PDU SESSION MODIFICATION REQUEST message contains Extended protocol configuration options IE.
